title: O God, by Whom the Seed Is Given
description: O God, by Whom the Seed Is Given in Tonic Solfa to ST. PETER, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Reginald Heber wrote these words. They were printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 65, “The Seed of the Word”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. PETER; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O God, by whom the seed is given, By whom the har-vest blest; Whose word, like man-na showered from heaven, Is plant-ed in our breast;

lines: O God, by whom the seed is given,
Whose word, like manna showered from heaven,
Preserve it from the passing feet,
Though buried deep, or thinly strewn,
The hope, in earthly furrows sown,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: Reginald Heber died in 1826.
credits: Words by Reginald Heber (1783–1826), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to ST. PETER by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
